get.description: Create/reuse an unprivileged ten-minute CSRF precontext, never renew a human session.

post.description: Consume preauth once, issue independent opaque session and return safe SessionView.

get.description: Introspect current metadata without extending idle time, even if marked interactive.

post.description: Revoke the original session and delete its HttpOnly cookie.
Change only the caller's credential; all devices must authenticate again.

get.description: List current accounts only for a normal administrator, never accept permissions from query/body.

post.description: Create an account with mandatory renewal, returning Location/ETag and no credential.

get.description: Resolve the object only after the middleware has authenticated and authorized an administrator.

put.description: Replace editable attributes with locked revision/session checks; own effective edits delete the cookie.

post.description: Reset another account without revealing its previous credential; require a fresh ETag.

get.description: Read fixed-cutoff administrative history from audit009; no edit/delete or original-payload response.

AccountIdentity.title: AccountIdentity
AccountIdentity.description: Minimal self identity included only in a valid session response.

AccountPage.title: AccountPage

AccountReset.title: AccountReset

AccountUpdate.title: AccountUpdate
AccountUpdate.description: Replace only the three editable account attributes, with an external revision precondition.

AccountView.title: AccountView
AccountView.description: Approved administrative projection; never serialize password_hash or auth_version.

AdministrationActor.title: AdministrationActor
AdministrationActor.description: Stable trusted historical actor, independent of current account activation.

AdministrationEntry.title: AdministrationEntry
AdministrationEntry.description: Read-only administrative projection of shared audit009 evidence.

AdministrationTarget.title: AdministrationTarget
AdministrationTarget.description: Approved affected-object reference, never an original body or unapproved payload.

FieldProblem.title: FieldProblem
FieldProblem.description: Sanitized schema field path and fixed messages, excluding submitted values/context.

HistoryPage.title: HistoryPage
HistoryPage.description: Stable descending evidence page with a fixed cutoff authenticated in its continuation.

LoginInput.title: LoginInput
LoginInput.description: Bounded syntax only; invalid email syntax inside this bound receives a generic denial.

PasswordInput.title: PasswordInput
PasswordInput.description: Passwords preserve every Unicode code point and whitespace; confirmation is client-only.

ProblemView.title: ProblemView
ProblemView.description: Published error envelope; operation reference is an opaque server UUID.

SessionView.title: SessionView
SessionView.description: Client metadata and in-memory CSRF; the HttpOnly bearer is never serialized.
